title: Longer MCP requests can finish
summary:
MCP requests got room to finish, SDK errors got clearer, and the community app catalog got a little more useful.

Authenticated MCP requests no longer stop automatically after 30 seconds, while caller-provided cancellation still works. Chat completions also stopped passing an obsolete timeout option.

Pollinations.models() now returns the model array promised by its type. Failed image-edit downloads now surface the API error message, code and HTTP status instead of being treated as image data.

The image catalog gained IMADreamer, while 56 rows pointing to unavailable or unsuitable destinations were removed. The README’s Latest News was also refreshed with an August 11 entry about visual previews for retained apps.
